description: This file implements compression and decompression functions for a configuration data structure, specifically for serializing and deserializing 'config' objects with schema-based compression, used in network traffic within the Wesnoth game project.

methods.name: compress_output_literal_word
methods.description: Writes a literal word to the output stream, including a null terminator.

methods.name: add_word_to_schema
methods.description: Adds a new word to the compression schema, mapping it to a character code.

methods.name: get_word_in_schema
methods.description: Retrieves a word's code from the schema or adds it if not present and space allows.

methods.name: compress_emit_word
methods.description: Outputs a word using schema compression if possible, otherwise as a literal.

methods.name: compress_read_literal_word
methods.description: Reads a null-terminated string from input stream.

methods.name: write_compressed_internal
methods.description: Recursively writes a config object to stream with compression.

methods.name: write_compressed
methods.description: Serializes a config object to stream with schema-based compression.

methods.name: read_compressed_internal
methods.description: Recursively reads a compressed config object from stream.

methods.name: read_compressed
methods.description: Deserializes a config object from stream with schema-based decompression.
